“The Wedding Wale” A.K.A Reetu Jain, Jignesh Chouhan and Team.

They work very systematically. They set up the Timeline and Budget allocation chart at the onset. Like they tell you how to go about the wedding, make a timeline of things to do and allocate budgets based on your requirement starting from save the date, pre wedding photo shoot, invites, text messages to guests, artists bookings, venue recces, RSVP’s, food menus basically everything. This helps as you are working well ahead of time, in your stipulated budget and are relaxed.

The good thing about them is they are willing to go the extra mile until you are satisfied or see that smile on the client’s face.

Their USP is their Varmala and couple entries for each event. Irrespective of your budget- they plan in detail and truly make the Varmala and couple entries special and memorable for you. You could book them just for this.

We had endless late night long phone calls , many many meetings, million texts but they were always always available and consistent.

There are many wedding planners out there and tonnes of new ideas in the wedding industry every day. What I figured is on your big day you need a team that you trust and who work for you with a big smile and a warm heart.

I can vouch for the Wedding Wale team on that.
